bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities, establishing a repeatable trust framework for partner-led deployments.
Built an AWS shared-responsibility operating model that clearly delineated insurer-owned controls, creating a governance blueprint for scaling technical guidance across regulated partner engagements.

Led AWS modernization execution converting monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads into cloud-based architectures, delivering a repeatable technical blueprint for legacy-to-cloud transitions.
